caption: The drawing depicts a wall clock with a wooden case. At the top of the clock is a small carved eagle facing to the left. The clock face is circular with a cream background, displaying black Roman numerals and two black hands, encased in a brown wooden circular frame. Below the clock face is an ornate, vase-shaped wooden section with carved scrollwork and leaf patterns. The central section transitions to a rectangular wooden base, which is plain with subtle wood grain texture. The bottom of the clock case features a downward-pointing, acorn-like finial. The overall color scheme is brown tones for the wood with a light, off-white background for the drawing. The clock is centered on a plain, light-colored background with no other objects present.
title: Wall Clock
